floor_history.headline: Recon: floor 21 mapped to exactly two regions (symbol-fold on +0x44C displaced accesses; 2 missing full reloads of D_800A3878[3] = the whole 178-vs-185 shortfall); 3 spelling axes KILLED, region-B mec

frontier.hypothesis: The original C performs a store THROUGH A POINTER between the flag reads, which invalidates every MEM (including the D_800A3878 symbol load) and produces target's three full reloads -- closing the entire 7-insn shortfall.
frontier.mechanism: cc1 CSE/alias: an unknown-address store kills all cached MEM values, whereas a named-symbol store kills only same-symbol MEMs (measured this session: the named-symbol store recovered the lbu reload but not the lw).
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate the stores the function ALREADY performs that can legitimately be spelled as pointer stores (e.g. the D_800A390F write, the eda/q writes of the preceding block), place each between the two flag ifs, and measure sandbox + diff for a 3-reload shape. Never invent a store -- an added one is a dead-store cheat.

frontier.hypothesis: If no honest pointer-store placement yields three full reloads, the original reads were volatile-qualified.
frontier.mechanism: Volatile MEMs are never CSE'd, which reproduces target's per-site reload exactly; but this is gated by [[legitimate-volatile-interrupt-touched]]'s two-prong test, not freely available.
frontier.next_probe: Census every writer of D_800A3878 across src/ and asm/funcs/ and classify whether any is reached from an IRQ/callback handler. A negative census CLOSES this axis (a failed gate, not an open question); a positive one is a ruling-request, not a self-approval.

frontier.hypothesis: Region A's fold is performed by a specific cc1 pass whose guard condition names the property the base pseudo must lack; the C-spelling axis is dead (K1/K2) so the next step is forensic.
frontier.mechanism: Symbol substitution into a displaced MEM address happens in cse1 or combine; reading the per-pass RTL tells us which, and what stops it.
frontier.next_probe: Run `cc1 <build flags> -da` on the preprocessed TU into tmp/grind/func_8003B9D0/s2/, diff the .cse1 vs .combine dumps around the three +0x44C MEMs. Re-measure region A after any region-B change first -- $s0 liveness couples the two regions.
